channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Aug 20
item.description:
55 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Improved navmesh sampling by flood‑filling reachable polygons, eliminating a 7× spike in path‑finding time on the oilrig when points landed on unreachable islands.
  • Corrected misaligned caret in the command‑palette search when the query is empty.
  • Adjusted positioning of the Krieg chainsword small weapon rack for proper placement.

NPC & AI

  • Fixed old scientists not moving at multiple locations, corrected crouch‑walk angle on stairs, resolved AI getting stuck and slowed old AI behavior; also fixed an animal getting stuck in a charge stack around jungle trees.
  • Improved navmesh sampling by flood‑filling reachable polygons, eliminating a 7× spike in path‑finding time on the oilrig when points landed on unreachable islands.

UI

  • Fixed player preview eyes being black in the character customization UI and made the eyes follow the camera when orbiting the player.
  • Corrected misaligned caret in the command‑palette search when the query is empty.
  • Repaired "Show use bind" and "Show belt bar binds" settings so they now correctly toggle the corresponding UI elements.
  • Adjusted conversation readout timings for smoother dialogue pacing.

World Objects & Items

  • Adjusted positioning of the Krieg chainsword small weapon rack for proper placement.
  • Updated propane tank model and fixed random disappearing issue in its LODs.
  • Fixed double LOD renderers on corn and salvaged hammer world models, preventing visual glitches.

Monuments

  • Fixed chainlink fences in monuments that had incorrect material overrides on LOD1.

Vehicles & Gameplay

  • Added a repairable helipad at Bandit Camp; players must contribute resources to unlock air‑vehicle purchases, functioning like siege‑weapon construction.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Aug 18
item.description:

Gameplay & AI
